intro: In the beginning, Stargate was an equal joint venture between Glencore and a prominent Indonesian mining conglomerate. They commenced operation in 2009 and continued with Direct Shipping Ore for export until the ban of ore export in January of 2014.

In April 2017, ASPIRE group acquired 100% stake of Stargate, with the intention of developing Stargate nickel project from a mining only operation into nickel processing, for ferronickel and new energy nickel battery materials.

purpose.heading: Our Purpose
purpose.body: Let's build our nations through our pure and renewable green nickel production. Our aspiration is to passionately weave dreams into reality through our pure and renewable journey together in creating a better present.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: Our present vision is to be the national leader in nickel mining and processing with supreme commitment to ethical and social and environmental responsibilities. Our determination is to productively enrich and nourish the quality of lives of our people and natural resources through eternal improvement of our efficient operational excellence.

values.heading: Our Values
body: Our purpose of creating a better present starts from within ourselves and our spirituality, as it is the core of our corporate, our family, our community and our environment.
Our individuals who believe by heart the importance of conducting superior action, communication and relationships are of integrity, respect, honesty, openness, fairness, accountability and trust.
Our courage and determination to excel with imagination and dream, to dare to take on bigger responsibilities and improve ourselves into excellence.
Our cultivation of leaderships that are within us that leads into synergic, mutually beneficial and respectful teamwork.
Our passionate presence that will make sure a successful future for our next generation and enrich meaningful changes to world's history.

timeline.body: PT Samudera Sejahtera acquired 100% of PT Stargate.
Indonesia Government banned export of raw nickel ore.
ASPIRE was established. In April 2017, ASPIRE group acquired 100% of PT Stargate, with the intention of developing PT Stargate into nickel processing company.

ASPIREstargate restructuring is completed. Signed SPA with PLN for power purchase and supply, and HOA for PLN to build 450MW PLTGU on the site. Appointed MottMac to design its Industrial Park master plan. Awarded EPC Contract to Sinosteel to build 2x33MVA RKEF.

ASPIREstargate to restart its mining project with 2.4 million tons of high grade annual shipments in the South Deposit (Lameruru and Molore). ASPIREstargate to start construction of 2x33MVA RKEF. ASPIREstargate to become public listed company in IDX.
ASPIREstargate to produce green sustainable new energy nickel battery materials for EV, and invest in renewable wind and solar energy.
